calendarFaqs.q: When is Mansfield ISD Spring Break in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring Break runs Monday, March 15, through Friday, March 19, 2027. Students return Monday, March 22.

calendarFaqs.q: What are the Mansfield ISD bad-weather makeup days?
calendarFaqs.a: February 12 and March 26, 2027, are scheduled holidays that may become instructional days if Mansfield ISD needs to recover lost time.

calendarFaqs.q: What does SDCE mean on the Mansfield ISD calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: SDCE stands for Staff Development Credit Equivalency. November 23 and March 15 are student holidays marked as SDCE days on the district calendar.

calendarFaqs.q: Does Mansfield ISD publish an A/B calendar for 2026–27?
calendarFaqs.a: Yes. Mansfield ISD publishes a separate A/B calendar for schedules that use alternating A and B days.

calendarFaqs.q: Where can I find the official Mansfield ISD calendar PDF?
calendarFaqs.a: The official Option A PDF and separate A/B PDF are linked in the Calendar Resources section. Mansfield ISD's live event calendars are also linked for district and campus events.

customSections.label: What Mansfield ISD Families Should Know About 2026–27

groups.label: SDCE days
items: SDCE stands for Staff Development Credit Equivalency. November 23 and March 15 are student holidays marked as SDCE days; eligible professional employees may use approved professional development for SDCE credit.

groups.label: Why students return January 7
items: Winter Holiday ends January 1, but January 4–6 remain student holidays while staff complete professional-learning and work days. The second semester begins Thursday, January 7.

groups.label: Bad-weather makeup days
items: February 12 and March 26 are scheduled holidays, but either date may become an instructional day if Mansfield ISD needs to recover time lost to weather.

customSections.label: What Changed From 2025–26
customSections.content: School starts and ends one day earlier than in 2025–26, and Mansfield ISD's second bad-weather makeup day moves from April 3 to March 26.

customSections.label: How Mansfield ISD's Calendar Compares With Nearby Districts
customSections.content: Mansfield ISD serves Mansfield and parts of Arlington, Grand Prairie, Burleson, Fort Worth, Venus, Alvarado, and Kennedale. Mansfield, Arlington, and Fort Worth ISDs share the same 2026–27 Thanksgiving, winter, and spring break ranges, but their first and last student days differ.
